name: AI CLI Tools
description: Installs AI coding assistant CLIs and agentic development tools: Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode, CodeRabbit, Beads (with Dolt), Specify CLI, QMD, and Claude Agent ACP.

install.description: Comma-separated list of CLIs to install (e.g. 'claudeCode,geminiCli'). When set, only the listed CLIs are installed. When empty (default), all CLIs are installed.

omit.description: Comma-separated list of CLIs to exclude (e.g. 'codex,copilot'). When set, the listed CLIs are skipped. Applied after 'install' filtering.
